decisionBasis: P1 stop conditions are reproduced in the isolated WORK-420 composition root. Passing local tests and PARTIAL/SELF_CHECK evidence do not mitigate server-side participant authorization, commit-time membership revalidation, or current-head validation failures.

findings.claim: Every aggregate transition is bound to the current server-resolved participant and membership.
findings.evidence: actorForOperation returns undefined for SUBMIT_REQUEST, CREATE_MILESTONE, START_MILESTONE, and MARK_DELIVERY_PENDING; validateAuthority accepts undefined actors. Independent fixture execution with account:work420:unrelated returned ok:true for SUBMIT_REQUEST, and after a valid Agreement returned ok:true for CREATE_MILESTONE, START_MILESTONE, and MARK_DELIVERY_PENDING. No target test rejects an unrelated active member for these operations.

findings.claim: The branded one-shot Server Context is revalidated immediately before the durable mutation, including current membership.
findings.evidence: Membership is consumed at lines 1313-1328, but no membership revalidation occurs between authority resolution/apply and commit. Work420CommitInput carries no membership identity or revision. Independent fixture execution revoked the requester inside resolveAuthority, after context consumption and before commit; SUBMIT_REQUEST still returned ok:true with status SUBMITTED.

findings.claim: Every current record/head is verified before each transition, so a saved stale downstream record cannot be used.
findings.evidence: verifyCurrentAggregate checks currentHeads.requestRevision and currentHeads.quoteRevision only; agreement, milestone, delivery, acceptance, rights, payment, and ledger heads are not compared. After a valid Agreement, an independent fixture changed only currentHeads.agreementRevision to agreement:v999; CREATE_MILESTONE returned ok:true. The checked test covers a tampered hash and cross-root Quote, not downstream current-head mismatch.

findings.claim: Existing Market/Direct Work routes and FP-002/FP-003/FP-004 files are untouched.
findings.evidence: The isolated source has no static browser, network, Supabase, Market, Commission, PiXiSYNC, PXD, DB, or Storage access, and all observed WORK-420 artifacts are inside the declared globs. The shared worktree already contains 1131 out-of-scope dirty entries, so this audit does not attribute them to WORK-420 and cannot elevate the self-asserted baseline to an independent clean-tree proof.

commands.result: 12 passed, 0 failed; insufficient negative coverage for the P1 findings
